correctness.rationale: Expanding right self-distributivity gives exactly two coefficient equations. With diagonal parameter 2, either both cross B-coefficients vanish, forcing the decoupled class, or the cross T-coefficients both equal 2 and the remaining equation is uv=1. Unit F entries exclude u=1. This proves the complete stated two-fiber classification. Direct exhaustive replay at p=5,7,11 independently checks the symbolic result and all quandle axioms.
